name: European Patent Application
aliases: draft a patent application for the epo
description: A direct European patent application filed before the European Patent Office (EPO) under the European Patent Convention (EPC, Articles 75, 78, 87, 88, 123(2) and Rules 42, 43). Establishes an EP filing date and priority position across all EPC Contracting States.
jurisdiction_notes: Governed by the European Patent Convention (EPC, 1973/2000), Regulations under the EPC, and the EPO Guidelines for Examination. Direct EP filing must be strictly distinguished from entry into the European regional phase from an existing PCT application (PCT Articles 22/39(1) / Rule 159 EPC).

claim_rules.two_part_form_rule: Rule 43(1) EPC — preamble and characterising portion when closest prior art is known; neutral formulation when unknown
claim_rules.multiple_independent_claims_rule: Rule 43(2) EPC — restricted to plural interrelated products, different uses, or alternative solutions to a specific problem

required_inputs.label: Technical Problem and Limitations of Existing Approaches
Technical Solution and Core Inventive Concept

sections.title: TITLE OF THE INVENTION
sections.description: Short, clear, and technical title indicating the technical subject matter without fancy names.

sections.title: TECHNICAL FIELD
sections.description: Specifies the technical field to which the invention relates.

sections.title: BACKGROUND ART
sections.description: Mentions the background art which can be regarded as useful for understanding the invention. Stated neutrally if no closest prior art is known.

sections.title: SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION
sections.description: Discloses the invention in technical terms such that the technical problem and its solution can be understood, stating the technical effects and advantages.

sections.title: BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF THE DRAWINGS
sections.description: Briefly describes the figures in the drawings, if any.

sections.title: DETAILED DESCRIPTION OF EMBODIMENTS
sections.description: Describes in detail at least one way of carrying out the invention, using examples where appropriate and referring to drawings.

sections.title: CLAIMS
sections.description: Defines the matter for which protection is sought in terms of technical features, clear and concise, supported by description.

sections.title: ABSTRACT
sections.description: Concise summary of the disclosure serving exclusively for technical information purposes, preferably not exceeding 150 words.
